summary: T-Head, Alibaba’s chip subsidiary, today unveiled its next-generation Zhenwu V900 AI chip for both training and inference at the 2026 Apsara Conference in Hangzhou. The company also outlined its roadmap for future Yitian server CPUs. The announcements show T-Head expanding beyond individual AI accel
